en.topic_title: Tai Po fire investigation will not be converted to more powerful inquiry commission, chair says
en.topic_summary:
An independent committee set up to probe the cause of last November’s deadly Tai Po fire has decided that it will not be converted into a commission of inquiry with statutory powers to summon witnesses, chairperson David Lok has said.



Judge David Lok on March 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP



Lok, a High Court judge, said that substantial evidence had already been collected and witnesses’ cooperation might not be guaranteed, even if they are summoned, local media reported.
